about: 7 Wonders Duel Pantheon: the Pantheon board, the Offering tokens and the structure slots that hold tokens (docs/spec-pantheon.md P-A3, R1). Card game facts (c) Repos Production.

format.spaces: the 6 Pantheon spaces, numbered 1-6 from the end nearest P1's capital (the Conflict Pawn's negative end) to the end nearest P2's; cost = [P1's activation cost, P2's activation cost]
format.mythologySlots: Age I structure slots (numbered as in data/base/layouts.json) that get a Mythology token at setup
format.offeringSlots: Age II structure slots that get an Offering token at setup
format.offerings: the Offering tokens: a single-use discount of that many coins on an activation
